browse_api.description:
Michel Legrand and His Orchestra – Castles in Spain
Columbia Records – CL 888
U.S. Mono LP

An early orchestral album from celebrated French composer, arranger, and conductor Michel Legrand, built around musical impressions of Spain. The record combines orchestral pop, jazz-influenced arranging, and Spanish themes including flamenco-inspired material.

Tracks include:

España
Sentir de la Alhambra
La Danse du Feu
Andalucía
El Gato Montés
Tango
España Cañí
Jungle Drums
Oriental
Malagueña
La Violetera
El Choclo
Rondella Aragonesa
Sant Martí del Canigó

Vinyl retains strong gloss and shows light visible surface marks consistent with normal handling and play. No obvious major scratches are visible in the photos. Visually graded VG+.

Original Columbia jacket remains attractive with light age-related wear, minor edge/corner wear, and some discoloration/toning. Cover graded approximately VG to VG+.

Please review all photos carefully, as they are part of the condition description.
